messages:
ryan: Noticed another docs drift in examples/voice-assistant. The sample uses the old streaming callback API and `usage.tokens` parsing. New SDKs changed names and streaming signature.

meenal: Which file? I can grep for streaming callbacks and `usage.tokens`.

ryan: examples/voice-assistant/README.md and examples/voice-assistant/app.js. The README has a Node streaming snippet like:
```js
const stream = client.streamResponse({ input: 'wake up' });
stream.on('data', chunk => process.stdout.write(chunk.text));
stream.on('end', () => console.log('done'));
const lastUsage = stream.usage.tokens; // old shape
```
That `stream.usage.tokens` is nonexistent now and will throw. Also the `stream.on` handlers are slightly different in the new SDK (we moved to `onChunk` and `onComplete`).

meenal: Ah yeah. We renamed the streaming callbacks to reduce confusion. The migration guide covers it but examples should be current.

ryan: I hacked a quick replacement suggestion:
```js
const client = RedwoodClient.fromEnv();
const { streamId } = await client.stream.start({ input: 'wake up' });
await client.stream.onChunk(streamId, chunk => process.stdout.write(chunk.delta));
const result = await client.stream.onComplete(streamId);
console.log('total tokens', result.usage.total_tokens);
```
This shows env-based auth, the new streaming API, and the new usage path.

doc-qa-bot: Quick failure pattern detected: examples contain `usage.tokens` (count: 3), `RedwoodClient(` with literal apiKey (count: 1), and deprecated `stream.on` usage (count: 2). Recommend PR.

meenal: Nice. Can you open a docs PR, add a small example test that runs `node examples/voice-assistant/app.js` under a mocked client, and add a CHANGELOG note in the examples folder so we track snippet upgrades?

ryan: Will do. Also propose adding a tiny post-merge job in docs CI that runs `node --check` on JS snippets and a python -m pyflakes on python snippets so obvious syntax drift fails the build. Low friction and catches copy/paste issues.

ops: FYI we had one customer in support ticket #8124 who copy/pasted the old streaming snippet and hit a runtime error in prod. We rolled back the change but this will reduce noise.

meenal: Good catch. I'll prioritize the PR this afternoon and tag @ryan for review.

doc-qa-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4231 — updates voice-assistant snippets, migrates streaming API usage, moves auth to fromEnv(), and adds unit test + CI snippet checks.

ryan: Thanks. Also adding a TODO to onboarding checklist: "run examples through snippet-checker after each SDK release" so new hires don't accidentally ship stale code.

meenal: Added to onboarding doc in the PR. :rocket:

ryan: Great, will monitor the CI run. If the snippet-checker flags anything else I'll create follow-ups.
